description: This file contains the implementation of a UI view for usage analytics, including rendering functions, data processing, and user interaction handling for a usage dashboard in a web application.

methods.name: createEmptyUsageTotals
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty UsageTotals object with all numeric fields initialized to zero.

methods.name: addUsageTotals
methods.description: Accumulates usage data into a UsageTotals object, summing corresponding fields.

methods.name: renderUsageLoadingState
methods.description: Returns HTML for the loading state of the usage view, including spinners and disabled date inputs.

methods.name: renderUsageEmptyState
methods.description: Returns HTML for the empty state of the usage view with a refresh button.

methods.name: renderUsage
methods.description: Main function that renders the entire usage dashboard UI based on provided data, filters, display settings, details, and callbacks.
